GOVERNMENT OF INDIA 
MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
  
LOK SABHA 
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 1139 
ANSWERED ON 5TH FEBRUARY, 2026 
  
BHARATMALA PARIYOJANA (PHASE-I) IN KARNATAKA 
1139.  SHRI E TUKARAM: 
Will the Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
सड़क परिवहन औि िाजमार्ग मंत्री 
be pleased to state:  
(a) the total number of projects approved under the Bharatmala Pariyojana 
(Phase–I) in the  State of Karnataka, along with their sanctioned cost and 
proposed timelines; 
(b) whether the Union Government has com pleted any of these projects, 
particularly in the district of Ballari; 
(c) if so, the details thereof, including length completed, expenditure incurred 
and date of completion; 
(d) if not, the reasons for delay, such as land acquisition, contractor issues o r 
shortage of funds; and 
(e) whether the Government has taken any specific measures to expedite the 
remaining projects and if so, the details thereof?   
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
(SHRI NITIN JAIRAM GADKARI) 
  
(a) to (d) The details of on -going/completed projects under the Bharatmala 
Pariyojana (Phase-I)  in the State of Karnataka as also in the district of Ballari 
along with cost and timelines and reasons for delay are annexed.  
  
(e) The Government actively monitors Nati onal Highway (NH) projects in 
close coordination with project implementing agencies, State Governments, 
contractors/developers. Periodic review meetings are held at various levels to 
resolve the issues and expedite progress. In addition, various initiative s have 
been taken to avoid or reduce project delays, including streamlining land 
acquisition & environment clearances, online approval of General Arrangement 
Drawing (GAD) of Railway Road Over Bridges (ROBs)/ Road Under Bridges 
(RUBs).
